title: Social Media Marketing Associate
description:
Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.
RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.
Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.
At a GlanceRVO Health is seeking a dynamic and creative Social Media Video Associate to elevate our brands across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. This role is central to developing compelling short-form content that resonates with our audience and aligns with the latest trends in social media. The ideal candidate will be skilled in video creation, editing techniques, and staying ahead of social media trends, particularly in the health and wellness space. 
Where You'll BeThis position is remote. 
What You’ll Do- Content Creation & Strategy: Develop and execute a cutting-edge social video strategy that drives brand awareness, engagement, and audience growth across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
- Trend Identification: Stay on top of social media trends, editing styles, and platform updates to ensure content is fresh, relevant, and impactful.
- Engagement & Community Building: Actively engage with followers, monitor conversations, and cultivate a vibrant online community.
- Content Calendar Management: Oversee the social video content calendar, from creative ideation to asset delivery, ensuring timely execution of all content. 
- Analytics & Reporting: Utilize analytics platforms to track performance, analyze trends, and provide actionable insights to optimize content.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Participate in brainstorms, ideation sessions, and work closely with cross-functional teams to align content with broader marketing goals.
- Content Production: Be self-sufficient in producing high-quality video content, including filming, editing, and post-production.
What We’re Looking ForRequired: 
- Experience & Expertise: 1-2 years of experience in social media marketing with a strong focus on video content creation, especially on TikTok and Instagram Reels.
- Platform Mastery: Deep knowledge of what performs well on these platforms, with a proven track record of creating content that drives engagement and brand visibility.
- Creative Innovation: Ability to think outside the box and bring fresh, inventive ideas to the table. A passion for health and wellness content is a plus.
- Technical Skills: Proficient in video editing software and tools, with a strong understanding of the latest editing techniques and trends.
- Analytical Skills: Strong ability to measure, track, and report on content performance, turning data into actionable insights. 
- Organizational Skills: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, pivoting quickly as priorities shift.
- Communication: Excellent caption writing skills with attention to detail, ensuring consistency in brand tone and voice.
- Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to quickly adapt to changes and feedback.
- Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently and within a team, driving results across various departments.
Preferred:
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Film, Public Health, or a related field.  
- Experience working within regulated industries, such as healthcare or pharmaceuticals, with an understanding of compliance considerations.  
- Knowledge of SEO and content marketing principles as they relate to social media.  
Pursuant to various state Fair Pay Acts, below is a summary of compensation elements for this role at the company. The following benefits are provided by RVO Health, subject to eligibility requirements.
- Starting Salary: $68,000 - $71,000 
*Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience
- Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
- Life Insurance
- Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
- Flexible Spending Accounts
- Paid Time Off
- Holiday Pay
- 401(k) with match
- Employee Assistance Program
- Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
- Pharmacy Benefits
- Income Protection Plans
- Pet Services Plans
- Mental Health Support
- Wellness Coaching
- HSA- Health Savings Account
- Commuter Benefits
- Gym & Fitness Center Discount Program
Hiring Timeline Notice
THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 02/19/2026.
Who We Are: 
RVO Health is a health-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group’s Optum. Together, we’ve brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. We're the #1 source for doctor search in the U.S. Every day, people turn to our brands in moments that matter to find reliable health information, connect with doctors, save money on prescriptions, and take meaningful action on their wellbeing.
RVO Health is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at RVO Health is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications.   
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodations@rvohealth.com.
We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.
